As the 2026 World Cup draws to a close, Major League Soccer (MLS) is set to make a strong return tomorrow on Apple TV, with multiple platforms including Apple Maps, Apple Sports, and Apple Fitness+ rolling out a host of related features. Here are the details.

MLS Lands on Apple TV

Apple today made a major announcement about the return of the MLS season, with six matches set to take place over the coming days:

July 16 (Thursday):

  • CF Montréal vs. Toronto FC (7:30 PM ET)
  • Chicago Fire vs. Vancouver Whitecaps (8:30 PM ET)
  • St. Louis City SC vs. Sporting Kansas City (8:30 PM ET)
  • Seattle Sounders vs. Portland Timbers (10:30 PM ET)

July 17 (Friday):

  • Nashville SC vs. Atlanta United FC (8:10 PM ET)
  • LA Galaxy vs. LAFC (10:15 PM ET)

To mark the return of the regular season, Apple announced a range of MLS-themed features across its platforms, including a brand-new Time to Walk audio experience for Apple Fitness+ subscribers.

The latest episode is hosted by German football legend Thomas Müller, in which he "shares the efforts behind his rise to fame and how he gracefully navigates the challenges of major life transitions."

Apple Music will also roll out a collection of exclusive playlists curated by star players, including Diego Luna of Real Salt Lake, Evander da Silva Ferreira of FC Cincinnati, as well as themed playlists from Eastern and Western Conference teams such as the New York Red Bulls, New York City FC, and Orlando City SC.

On Apple Maps, Apple will launch "matchday guides crafted by MLS clubs and city tours written personally by players, offering recommendations on where to watch the games, must-visit local hotspots, and detailed stadium information."

For regular Apple Sports app users, you can stay on top of the latest league news, including live scores, standings, ticker-style match updates, formation layouts, and team stats.

Finally, Apple stated:

MLS matches are available to Apple TV subscribers free of charge in over 100 countries and regions worldwide; Apple will also provide exclusive content throughout the season, as well as viewing access to cup competitions including the playoffs.

For more information on Apple's coverage of the MLS return, click here.

Apple TV is priced at US$12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed to via the Apple One bundle. The platform offers a range of hit series and films, including Severance, The Studio, The Morning Show, Shrinking, and Silo.
